_meta.scope: Subset relevant to A32x (CEO/NEO) narrow-body line and base maintenance. Helicopter-only and reserved chapters omitted or noted.

chapters.name: Time Limits / Maintenance Checks
chapters.scope: Inspection program, life limits, A/C/D check tasking, hard time and on-condition items.

chapters.name: Dimensions and Areas
chapters.scope: Aircraft station diagrams, zoning, access panels reference.

chapters.name: Lifting and Shoring
chapters.scope: Jacking, lifting, shoring procedures (gear swing, weighing prep).

chapters.name: Leveling and Weighing
chapters.scope: Weight & balance, CG calculation, fleet re-weigh.

chapters.name: Towing and Taxiing
chapters.scope: Towbar/towbarless tractors, taxi limits, ground steering.

chapters.name: Parking, Mooring, Storage and Return to Service
chapters.scope: Short/long term storage prep, preservation, return-to-service tasks.

chapters.name: Placards and Markings
chapters.scope: External/internal placards, decals, walkway markings, exit markings.

chapters.name: Servicing
chapters.scope: Routine servicing: oil/hyd replenish, fuel, tire pressure, water/waste.

chapters.name: Standard Practices - Airframe
chapters.scope: Common airframe procedures: torque, bonding, sealing, cleaning, NDT general.

chapters.name: Air Conditioning
chapters.scope: Pack system, cabin pressurization, ventilation, recirc, temperature control.

chapters.name: Auto Flight
chapters.scope: Autopilot, autothrust, FMGC/FMS, FCU panel, autoland.

chapters.name: Communications
chapters.scope: VHF/HF radios, ACARS/ATSU, SATCOM, intercom, CVR (recording).

chapters.name: Electrical Power
chapters.scope: Generators (IDG), TR, batteries, RAT, external power, distribution.

chapters.name: Equipment / Furnishings
chapters.scope: Cabin seats, galleys, lavs, IFE, cargo nets, emergency equipment.

chapters.name: Fire Protection
chapters.scope: Engine/APU/cargo fire detection and extinguishing, smoke detectors, lav fire bottles.

chapters.name: Flight Controls
chapters.scope: Ailerons, elevators, rudder, slats, flaps, spoilers, ELACs/SECs/FACs, trim.

chapters.name: Fuel
chapters.scope: Tanks, pumps, FCMC/FQI, refuel/defuel, crossfeed, vents, fuel temperature.

chapters.name: Hydraulic Power
chapters.scope: Green/Yellow/Blue systems, EDPs, electric pumps, PTU, RAT, accumulators, reservoirs.

chapters.name: Ice and Rain Protection
chapters.scope: Wing anti-ice, engine anti-ice, probe heat, windshield heat/wipers, rain repellent.

chapters.name: Indicating / Recording
chapters.scope: ECAM, EFIS, clocks, FDR, DFDAU, CMS, BITE, printer, on-board library.

chapters.name: Landing Gear
chapters.scope: MLG/NLG structure, wheels & tires, brakes (BSCU), steering (BSCU), retraction, doors, position indication.

chapters.name: Lights
chapters.scope: Cockpit, cabin, exterior (landing/taxi/nav/strobe/logo/wing inspection), emergency egress lighting.

chapters.name: Navigation
chapters.scope: ADIRS, GPS, ILS/MMR, VOR/DME, TCAS, GPWS/EGPWS, weather radar, RA, transponder.

chapters.name: Oxygen
chapters.scope: Crew O2 (cylinder), passenger O2 (chemical generators), portable bottles.

chapters.name: Pneumatic
chapters.scope: Bleed manifold, HP/IP valves, precoolers, crossbleed, leak detection (bleed loops).

chapters.name: Water / Waste
chapters.scope: Potable water tank/lines, waste tank, vacuum waste system, lav servicing.

chapters.name: Integrated Modular Avionics
chapters.scope: IMA cabinets, AFDX networks (NEO), CPIOM/IOM modules.

chapters.name: Cabin Systems
chapters.scope: PA, cabin intercom (CIDS), passenger info signs, IFE control.

chapters.name: Onboard Maintenance System
chapters.scope: CMS, BITE consolidation, post-flight reports, troubleshooting interface.

chapters.name: Information Systems
chapters.scope: ATSU, NSS (NEO), e-library, EFB integration, network server.

chapters.name: Inert Gas / Nitrogen Generation
chapters.scope: Fuel tank inerting (NGS) — A320 family fitted on most.

chapters.name: Airborne Auxiliary Power (APU)
chapters.scope: Honeywell 131-9A APU: starter, FCU, bleed valve, generator, ECU, oil, exhaust.

chapters.name: Standard Practices and Structures - General
chapters.scope: Repair classifications, allowable damage, NDT general, corrosion control program.

chapters.name: Doors
chapters.scope: Pax doors, cargo doors, avionics bay door, MLG doors hinges/latches/seals.

chapters.name: Fuselage
chapters.scope: Skin, frames, stringers, pressure bulkhead, belly fairing, lightning damage.

chapters.name: Nacelles / Pylons
chapters.scope: Engine nacelle structure, pylon attach, fan cowls, thrust reverser cowls (structure).

chapters.name: Stabilizers
chapters.scope: Horizontal stab (THSA), vertical stab/fin.

chapters.name: Windows
chapters.scope: Cockpit windshields & side windows, cabin windows, heating, demisting.

chapters.name: Wings
chapters.scope: Wing box, leading/trailing edge, fuel tanks structural, sharklet/wingtip.

chapters.name: Power Plant - General
chapters.scope: Engine installation, mounts, drains, cowl quick-access, engine change kit.

chapters.name: Engine
chapters.scope: Fan, LPC/HPC, combustor, HPT/LPT, gearbox, bearings, borescope inspections.

chapters.name: Engine Fuel and Control
chapters.scope: FADEC/EEC, HMU, fuel filter, IDG cooler, fuel manifold, nozzles.

chapters.name: Ignition
chapters.scope: Ignition exciters, leads, igniter plugs.

chapters.name: Engine Air / Bleed
chapters.scope: VBV, VSV, HPC bleed, anti-ice valves on engine.

chapters.name: Engine Controls
chapters.scope: Throttle quadrant linkage, fuel shutoff signaling, master switches.

chapters.name: Engine Indicating
chapters.scope: N1/N2/EGT/FF indications, vibration sensors, oil pressure/temp xducers.

chapters.name: Exhaust / Reversers
chapters.scope: Exhaust nozzle/plug, thrust reverser system (HCU, blocker doors, T/L locks).

chapters.name: Engine Oil
chapters.scope: Oil tank, scavenge/pressure pumps, MCD, oil filter, fuel-oil heat exchanger.

chapters.name: Engine Starting
chapters.scope: Starter air valve, starter, start sequencing.
